title: Rival and table styles - House of Pips Wiki
description: Who Rival is, his skill levels and table styles, and what Rival School teaches.
html:
Rival and table styles

Rival is your opponent across the table in solo matches. He drafts perks and maluses from the same cards you do, and his perks have the same effects as yours. When Rival uses a perk, the table pauses on a notice so you can see what happened; the ledger records it too.

Skill levels #

Rival sits down at one of three skill levels. In Custom mode you choose the level.

Skill levelIn the game
CasualEasygoing company. Rival plays loose and leaves openings.
StrategicA sharper opponent. Rival plays with intent and punishes loose bones.
AnalyticalThe toughest seat at the table. Rival gives nothing away.

Table styles #

Rival plays with a style: a plan for the table. Rival School has one lesson for each style, and in Custom mode you can pick Rival's style.

StyleTable plan
Score HoundChases immediate points and keeps the scoring initiative.
Table ControllerKeeps bones open and preserves several routes through the rack.
Lock ArtistUses public draw and pass clues to squeeze the opponent's playable ends.
CounterpuncherLeaves stingy board counts and denies easy scoring replies.
Domino RacerBuilds a connected route to an empty rack and the next hammer.
Pip ShedderUnloads heavy and awkward bones before they can become a hand penalty.
Combo CrafterDrafts a scoring engine and favors plays that keep its perk triggers firing.

Rival School #

Open Tutorials and choose Enter Rival School (it opens after Nana's tutorial). Each lesson shows a real table position, asks you to choose between two playable options, and explains why the style picks the one it does. Completed lessons stay checked in your career, and finishing all seven earns the Know Your Rival achievement.

Rewards don't depend on difficulty #

Rival's skill level never changes the XP or Bone Bucks you earn.
